verdict.line: You lose if you let Renekton's Fury bar cross 50 before you can punish his dash cooldown; you win once your sustain items and his Dominus timer are both on cooldown at the same time.

brief.thesis: Renekton's Fury bar is a hard gate: below 50 Fury his Q (Cull the Meek) and W (Ruthless Predator) are survivable moderate hits, but at 50+ Fury his W becomes a three-hit, 1.5s stun that destroys shields and his Q's damage and heal both spike. The 50.1% head-to-head over 2019 games says this is winnable, but it's won by denying that threshold, not by out-damaging it directly.

theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) now lands a triple slash with a 1.5s stun that strips shields, and his Q heal jumps. Back off and reset the wave instead of trading auto for auto.

yourWindow.when: His E (Slice and Dice) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice is his only gap-closer and escape, on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown. With it down he can't dash in to start a combo or dash out of your Q (Thundering Smash) stun, so this is when you initiate.

powerCurve.note: Renekton's Q+W combo outtrades your one-cast kit
Fury builds fast off his short Q cooldown
Dominus threat vs your W heal stabilize trades
on-hit items outscale his Fury resets

start.why: The lifesteal on autos offsets the sustain Renekton gets back from his Q (Cull the Meek) heal during early short trades, and it sits at 50% win rate over 446 games as the matchup's secondary start.

boots.why: Renekton's entire kit is auto-attacks plus physical slashes; Steelcaps is the 60% pick rate, 50.1% win rate choice for a reason here — it directly undercuts his W and Q damage.

core.why: The active heal and spellblade proc stack with your W (Frenzied Maul) mark-and-heal combo, giving you a second sustain tool to match his Fury-boosted Q heal.
On-hit proc extends your poke threat alongside E (Sky Splitter), so you can chip him from range without walking into his W stun chain.
Toggling resistances covers Renekton's mixed physical burst from empowered W and Q once his Fury is high, part of the 53.6% win rate path over 84 games.

situational.when: renekton is stacking lifesteal or healing off his Q to win extended trades
his W stun chains are repeatedly locking you down before you can react
you need more raw healing amp to out-sustain his Fury-scaled Q in prolonged fights

runes.keystoneWhy: OP.GG's own read on this lane calls out Grasp specifically for fighting Renekton — the max-health proc and bonus health reward the long trades you want to force instead of short all-in exchanges where his Fury snowballs.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 72.2% of games here at 50.6% win rate — Ignite punishes his Q self-heal directly, cutting into the sustain that makes his Fury all-ins scary.

playing.title: Poke from brush, not melee range
playing.detail: Per OP.GG's own tip, use E (Sky Splitter) from inside a brush to chip Renekton's health without stepping into his W (Ruthless Predator) stun range.

playing.title: Track his Fury before every trade
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury his Q and W are moderate; above 50, his W triples into a 1.5s stun that strips shields and his Q heal spikes. Disengage the moment he crosses that line.

playing.title: Double-cast W for the heal
playing.detail: Recasting Frenzied Maul on a marked target deals bonus damage and heals you — use this to win sustain races instead of trading single autos.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown and is his only dash. The moment he uses it to engage or reset, follow with Q (Thundering Smash) since he has no way to disengage.

playing.title: Don't contest his Dominus window
playing.detail: At level 6, Dominus grants bonus health and ongoing Fury generation — new fights right after he pops it favor him. Wait it out rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Save R for towers, not just damage
playing.detail: Stormbringer temporarily disables nearby towers on landing — hold it for a dive or a plate-denying engage, not as a reflexive damage tool.

playing.title: Initiate once your items land
playing.detail: Around levels 11-13 your on-hit core (Gunblade into Statikk Shiv) outpaces his Fury-gated damage — start flipping fights instead of waiting on him.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the Fury-threshold reasoning and trade-timing advice are our own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Check Renekton’s Fury before fighting him. Use [E] from inside a brush to contest lane while using Grasp of the Undying when fighting him.
